title: A.R.M.O.R. field-node information
description: What a node says about itself so that a console can offer its web panel: its name, the firmware it runs, and where it can be reached. Sent when the node connects to the broker and now and then afterwards.

name.description: The name the operator gave the node.

ip.description: The IPv4 address of the node, four decimal parts without leading zeros.

port.description: The port of the node's web panel.
